how_to_apply: Visit the official website at cftri.res.in and open the Recruitments section, or visit recruitment.cftri.res.in.
Read the detailed advertisement for and check the eligibility requirements and application instructions.
Complete and submit the online application between 19 October 2026 at 10:00 AM and 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Submit the hard copy of the online application in the manner specified in the detailed advertisement. It must reach the prescribed destination by 26 November 2026.
Check the official CFTRI website regularly for further announcements, updates, corrigenda and addenda.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute, Mysuru, has announced direct recruitment for Technician (1) posts under Advertisement No. Rec.02/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 28 vacancies have been announced for the Technician (1) post.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 19 October 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 18 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q5. Is a hard copy of the online application required?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification specifies that the hard copy of the online application must be received by 26 November 2026. Candidates should follow the submission instructions in the detailed advertisement.
